theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (κ : ℝ), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → 0 < κ → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, κ * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ G a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → G '' A ⊆ R.carrier → ∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict A), ∃ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧ ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G a (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ G a (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) * R.orient (G a) β = σ * β (fun k => fderiv ℝ G a (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))
